create_ConsoleLogger: create a ConsoleLogger callback to print training and validation loss to the console
create_TensorboardLogger: create a TensorboardLogger callback to log training and validation metrics to TensorBoard
create_WandbLogger: create a WandbLogger callback to log training metrics and model graphs to Weights and Biases
create_CheckpointSaver: create a CheckpointSaver callback to save model checkpoints at regular epoch intervals
create_ProgressBarLogger: create a ProgressBarLogger callback to display a rich progress bar during training epochs
